the court passed the following:
 C.S.DIAS, J.
 -------------------------------------
 B.A.No.11483 of 2023  --------------------------------------
 Dated this the 16th day of January, 2024  ORDER
The application is filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, for an order of pre- arrest bail.

2. The petitioner is the third accused in crime No.1833/2023 of the Paravoor Police Station, Kollam,
registered against the accused (3 in number) for allegedly committing the offences punishable under Sections 406, 420 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. Heard; Sri. Saju J Panicker, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and Smt.Seetha S.,
the learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondents.

sentences.text:
4. After bestowing my anxious consideration to the facts and the materials placed on record,
particularly taking note of the fact that the main allegation is against the accused 1 and 2, who have allegedly cheated the defacto complainant, I am of the view that the petitioner's custodial interrogation is not necessary.
Therefore, I am inclined to pass an interim order which will do complete justice to both sides.
5. In the result, the petitioner is directed to surrender before the Investigating Officer within one week from today for subjecting herself for interrogation.

After interrogation and in the event of petitioner's arrest, she shall be released on bail on executing bond for Rs.50,000/- (Rupees fifty thousand only) with two solvent sureties each to the like sum to the satisfaction of the investigating officer.
This order shall remain in force for a period of three weeks.

Sd/-
